name: Toyota 3VZE
notes: SOHC V6 (1988-1995), factory engine in the Toyota pickup/4Runner - not a Land Cruiser engine, but a real (if less commonly cited) swap option. Fuel-injected with its own ECU, though a much simpler system than modern V6es. Superseded by the DOHC 3VZ-FE (Camry/ES300 application, similar output) and later by the 5VZ-FE.
